text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation was extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tearing through the turf in one burst 
amidst a roar of cheers. Squeezing out 
every ounce of strength, she desperately 
clawed her way to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As expected, it was utterly breathtaking.
choice_data_list:
I knew it, no one else could be the star 
but you...!

I knew it, no one else could be the star 
but you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slowly but surely, the suppressed feelings 
began to bubble to the surface.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay to let her give up like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her own self-evaluation is remarkably 
low, but Win Variation is a truly talented 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume with such radiance that 
she could even become the star who steals 
every spectator's heart...!
choice_data_list: (――What can I do to stop them...!?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Good work today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it was my last race, I went 
and took 1st place. And the cheers were 
the loudest I've ever heard."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I perform better when she's not 
around.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, this sucks. Even at a time like 
this, all I can think about is Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I snapped out of it and looked at Win 
Variation. It felt like a wake-up call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right—to Win Variation, Orfevre was 
special. Even her envy and jealousy had 
fueled her drive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there's something that can be 
changed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bowed deeply to a bewildered Win 
Variation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Fan Appreciation Festival in a few 
weeks, races will be held by event 
category. We should be able to face off 
there.
choice_data_list:
I want you to run against Orfevre one last 
time.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't know what the result 
will be. ...It might even end up causing 
you more pain than you're feeling now. 
But—
choice_data_list:
Please, I need you to reconsider after 
that...!

Please, and after that, I want you to 
reconsider...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't bring myself to give up on 
her after all. I wanted you to hear this 
as my final, desperate plea.
choice_data_list: Leave Orfevre to me, I'll talk to her
I'll talk to Orfevre for you

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Begging someone to stay at the very last 
minute is the worst. There are heaps of 
things I need to reflect on.
choice_data_list:
(Still, right now... I can't afford to 
worry about appearances.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I've been thinking all along that 
today was the end—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if I did run... I just can't 
bring myself to try hard anymore.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...
choice_data_list:
No matter what, I just can't give up on 
you.

No matter what, I just can't give up on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That's... there's no way...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"You've truly done... so much for me, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why, just one last time... I will 
run with Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Sho was a race she had decided 
to run in from the start as a stepping 
stone toward the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It surely would have been a magnificent 
race." Thinking that, I simply couldn't 
bring myself to erase the scheduled "Tenno 
Sho (Spring)" entry—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, first comes the Fan 
Appreciation Festival. All I can do is 
pray that it moves her heart.
